title: Cloud Security: cash refund limits
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for cash refund limits.

## Basis

Original-payment refund methods: Refund destinations, restricted to the original payment rail; string list.

Minimum voluntary cash refund: Minimum voluntary cash refund; USD decimal.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Original-payment refund methods | Minimum voluntary cash refund |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | ACH, wire, card | 1 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | ACH, wire, card | 1 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | ACH, wire, card | 1 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | ACH, wire, card | 1 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | ACH, wire, card | 1 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | ACH, wire, card | 1 |

## Tier comparison

The listed cash refund limits bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
